summary: E2E validation of the reported bug fix: admin shares a page → common user receives it in 'Modelos salvos' (not pushed directly to page). Flow executed end-to-end via Playwright against the real Firebase env. Bug is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: checkInbox() in /app/frontend/public/app.js (~line 127) now correctly persists received shares as modelos via setDoc(doc(modelosColRef, modeloId), modelo) and unshifts into state.modelos + renderModelosSelect(). Behavior verified.

Anonymous auth errors in console (auth/admin-restricted-operation) occur before login. Expected per instructions but noisy; consider gating signInAnonymously behind a feature flag or catching silently to reduce noise.
app.js is 2900 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, shares/inbox, admin, modelos, render) for maintainability.

seed_data_creation: Each run of Passo 1 creates one new shares/{id} document in Firestore (audience=all) with the current admin page as modelo. Passo 3 imports it, creating a new users/{uid}/modelos/{id} for loja1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixed and validated. When user 'loja1@gestor.com' logged in, dropdown 'Modelos salvos' opened with count=11 and top row was 'Página (4 cartaz(es) · 4 por folha)' dated 28/09/2026 — the exact modelo enviado by admin in Passo 1 (page had a 4-cartaz layout). The 'Você recebeu N modelo(s)' toast may fade quickly; the authoritative check is the presence of the new row and increased count in #modelosPopList/#modelosPopCount. checkInbox runs at login. Note: user already had many previous 'Página (8 cartaz(es) ...)' etc from earlier tests, showing accumulation works idempotently via importedShares set on session doc.
rca of the issue: Original bug: checkInbox() was pushing received cartazes into state.cartazes (the user's active page) instead of storing them as reusable modelos. Fix: checkInbox() now clones the cartazes with fresh ids and persists them to users/{uid}/modelos via setDoc, updates state.modelos, re-renders the dropdown, and shows a toast. Verified E2E: admin sent a page and loja1 saw the new modelo at the top of 'Modelos salvos' immediately after login, without any modification to their current page.
